newsitem.title: USA: Sharper Image holiday sales rise 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sharper Image holiday sales rise 17 pct.

text.p: Sharper Image Corp said on Friday that sales for December 1, 1996 through December 25, 1996 were $49.5 million, 17 percent higher than the $42.4 million for the same prior year period.
Comparable store sales for the period increased by 10 percent.
The company said that sales for the four-day period of December 21 through 24 this year were 25 percent higher than last year's same period.
Comparable store sales for the four days rose 19 percent.
